name: Sammiana I4
description_md:
Sammiana I4 is a waymarked hiking route in MK that covers a distance of 204.2 km. This hard trail features 8215 m of ascent and 8048 m of descent.

The route is part of the national waymarked hiking network and is classified as difficult due to the distance and ascent. Hikers can expect to spend about 73 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule to complete the journey.
